description: Field reads off a local object literal. A read of a literal property, or of a property bound to an untainted identifier, is clean even though another property holds request data. A read of the tainted property, or of any property of a literal with a spread, keeps the taint.

expected.notes: cfg.auth.template is a nested string literal
job.bin is bound to the module constant BIN
the spread of req.body can supply opts.cmd
